label: Dei Filius ch. 4: there is a twofold order of knowledge, distinct in principle and in object; and…
paraphrase: Dei Filius ch. 4: there is a twofold order of knowledge, distinct in principle (by natural reason in the one, by divine faith in the other) and in object; and the Apostle testifies that God was known by the gentiles through the things that are made.
